# columnar-sql-engine

> Embeddable columnar SQL query engine in Go with vectorized batch execution, a rule-based optimizer, CSV tables and three-valued NULL logic. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u409-columnar-sql-engine`, package `columnarsqlengine`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
